title: SMProfile-Article payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/material/article.json 2.2.0; do not edit by hand. Envelope: standard/payloads/envelope.schema.json.

cost_hk.description: Standard manufacturing/purchase cost (HK = Herstellkosten), from ERP std_kosten. The €-basis for scrap / quality impact.

price_vk.description: Standard sales price (VK = Verkaufspreis), from ERP std_verkaufspreis. The basis for margin / lost-sales impact. Null for non-sellable articles (RAW/CONSUMABLE/WIP).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for cost_hk / price_vk, from ERP waehrung (e.g. EUR).

stock_free.description: Free (unblocked) stock of this article across all warehouses (menge_frei). Served by GET /api/articles, which is ARTICLE_WITH_STOCK_AND_PRICE_SQL. This is the article-level figure the WMS Quant rows sum to; a single Quant is one pallet/lot in one bin and is NOT a stock position.

stock_reserved.description: Quantity already committed to orders (menge_reserviert) — free stock that is spoken for.

stock_available.description: AVAILABLE-TO-PROMISE: free minus reserved (verfuegbar). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › stock_available › description.

reorder_level.description: Reorder level / Meldebestand from the ERP article master (mindestbestand). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › reorder_level › description.

safety_stock.description: Safety stock (safety_stock). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › safety_stock › description.

material_class_ref.description: The material class this article belongs to (DEFINED_BY), e.g. PA66-GF30. Empty until the article master or a mapping supplies it.
